exposure: fewer years of maternal formal education
cohort: The study utilized data from live births recorded in the Department of Informatics of the Unified Health System (DATASUS) in South Brazil.
finding: The study found specific incidences for CDH (0.93/10,000), EA (0.47/10,000), and GS (2.87/10,000) per live births in South Brazil, and identified various demographic and birth-related factors associated with these malformations.
mod_finding: All studied malformations (CDH, EA, GS) are associated with cesarean delivery.
